description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into a Google Sheets worksheet. Google Sheets has no upsert concept at the API level: this reads the entire worksheet, matches existing rows against key_column locally, updates changed rows in place, and appends new ones.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one sheet row (upserted via key_column).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated). No downstream data -- write side effect lands in the sheet.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

spreadsheet_id.label: Spreadsheet Id
spreadsheet_id.description: Google Sheets spreadsheet ID (from the sheet URL).

key_column.label: Key Column
key_column.description: Upstream column used to match existing rows for update-in-place. Must be present in fields_map keys.

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Upstream column -> sheet column header, in display order.

max_rows.label: Max Rows
max_rows.description: Safety cap on total rows per run.

name: Google Sheets Row Upsert
